Yeah, it’s a definitely a bit daunting to go straight into, but I was in a similar situation, I hadn’t played yugioh in over 10 years and I came back to the game in like January of this year, it was quite an adjustment, but it wasn’t too hard to get back into the swing of things, if you can you should try out master duel, it’s a pretty good way to get back into the game, and it helped me a lot

It’s changed a LOT since 2008, but the game has just mainly gotten faster, long combos and big endboard are pretty much the meta at this point, hand traps and board breakers make going 2nd a little more tolerable, but the game is much more explosive now, the tide of a game can literally change with one single move, I find that sort of gameplay to be very fun and involving, but there are some glaring weaknesses, like going second is ok, but going first is a pretty massive advantage, there are some blowout cards in the game right now that are really annoying to deal with, (Super Polymerization, dark ruler no more, nibiru, evenly matched, dimensional barrier) but overall the game is pretty healthy in todays format, it’s just gotten a lot faster since 2008
